s.note: Pulled ham hock on soft rolls with mustard slaw. Vic offers Toad a knuckle sandwich.
s.how: Cover the hocks, onion and bay leaves with water and simmer until the meat falls from the bone. Pull the meat into shreds, discarding skin and bone, and toss with the barbecue sauce and a splash of the liquid. Mix the cabbage with the mayo, mustard and vinegar. Pile the ham into the rolls, top with slaw and serve warm.

s.note: Crunchy fries under beef chilli with cheddar.
s.how: Brown the mince with the onion, then add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick. Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Pile the fries on a tray, spoon over the chilli and scatter with cheese. Flash under a hot grill until melted and top with spring onion.

m.note: Two smashed patties with American cheese and pickles on a soft bun.
m.how: Roll the mince into 8 balls and season well. Smash each ball flat onto a very hot greased pan with a sturdy spatula and cook until crusty. Flip, top with cheese and onion and cook another minute. Mix the mayo, tomato sauce and mustard and spread on the toasted buns. Stack two patties per bun with lettuce and pickles.

m.note: Grilled franks under beef chilli with raw onion.
m.how: Brown the mince with 1 onion, add the chilli powder and tomatoes and simmer until thick. Grill the franks, turning, until blistered. Toast the rolls, tuck in the franks and spoon over the chilli. Finish with cheese, mustard and the raw diced onion.
shop: 1 brown onion, diced, plus 1 for topping@Produce

w.note: Vanilla ice cream under hot fudge with malted crumbs. A white '56 cruising Third Street.
w.how: Heat 150ml cream with the golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir to a glossy fudge. Whip the rest of the cream with the malted milk powder to soft peaks. Scoop the ice cream into tall glasses and pour over the warm fudge. Top with malted cream, crushed Maltesers and a cherry.

d.note: Thick chocolate malted milkshake, two straws. Toad still can't buy the Old Harper.
d.how: Blend 8 scoops of vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk, 4 tbsp chocolate syrup and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into tall glasses with two straws each.
